NP Presspad 1.1.9 — Calmer notifications

Two improvements to how the app notifies you, especially when it syncs in the background while you're working elsewhere.

## What's new for you

- **No more piled-up toasts.** "Everything is OK"-style messages (like "Sync complete") now dismiss themselves after a few seconds even when the app isn't focused. Previously they waited for you to come back and stacked up. Errors, conflicts, and update prompts still stay on screen until you've seen them.
- **Dock badge for things that need you.** When an error or conflict notification is waiting, the Dock icon now shows a count — so you'll know something needs attention without the app shouting about the routine stuff. The badge clears as you dismiss the notifications.

No dependency changes in this release.
